records.vts_boundary_basis: Not inside any statutory VTS service area: Sjøtrafikkforskriften §6 is the complete list of six Norwegian VTS areas and their official polygons (R-S7) are all south of 62°03'N or at Melkøya (70°27'N to 71°06'N); this TSS (65°40'N to 65°50'N, 006°54'E to 007°20'E, R-S6) is outside all of them.
records.reporting_boundary_basis: Outside BARENTS SRS: the MSC.348(91) southern limit is 67°10'N (points A and B) and this TSS lies wholly south of it (65°40'N to 65°50'N, 006°54'E to 007°20'E). Outside WETREP: MSC.190(79) limit runs 58°30'N to 62°N along 000°, far to the west. No other IMO Part I system concerns Norway in the project inventory (IMO_2025_Mandatory_Reporting_Systems.csv). Kystverket's TSS navigation rules state routeing obligations only, no reporting.
records.evidence_summary: New TSS in the 'Off the coast of Norway' system from 1 June 2021 (R-S10), separately named in Kystverket data ('Trafikkseparasjonssystem utenfor Træna'). Kystverket's Barents SRS statement covers only 'Vardø to Røst'; geometry confirms the TSS is south of the Barents SRS limit. Not in any statutory VTS area (complete §6 list). NOR VTS information service for routeing schemes south of 65N exists (contact line) but is not a VTS area and involves no mandatory report.
records.source_date: MSC.348(91) 28 Nov 2012; MSC.190(79) 6 Dec 2004; Sjøtrafikkforskriften consolidated to FOR-2026-06-29-1454; accessed 29 Sep 2026
records.unresolved_issue: Residual: no single official list of all Norwegian national (non-IMO) mandatory reporting schemes was located; absence of a national EEZ transit-reporting obligation rests on the IMO Part I inventory, the Sjøtrafikkforskriften chapter structure (chapter 5, routeing only) and Kystverket's TSS rules page. Kystverket's navigation-rules page lists the 2007 system as 'Vardø - Træna', inconsistent with its own WFS naming and Barents page ('Vardø to Røst'); does not affect this classification.

sources.supports: Barents SRS participation thresholds, geographical boundary (points A to H), reporting to Vardø VTS centre (Norwegian monitoring area)

sources.passage: The centre monitors tankers and other risk vessels that follow the routing measures established outside the Norwegian coast.

sources.title: Navigation rules (TSS in the Norwegian economic zone)

sources.passage: Vessels in international traffic that may represent a high environmental risk must follow route measures that take these vessels further off the coast.

services.name: Vardø VTS centre (NOR VTS)
services.sectors: Statutory VTS area: Melkøya tjenesteområde (VHF 71, call sign NOR VTS). Separate information service for Barents SRS and routeing schemes (VHF 16).
services.area_description: Only declared VTS area is Melkøya tjenesteområde (Sjøtrafikkforskriften §6; polygon 70°27'N to 71°06'N, 022°34'E to 024°00'E). Also receives Barents SRS reports for the Norwegian monitoring area and monitors risk traffic in the offshore routeing measures, outside any VTS area.
services.operational_evidence: Kystverket contact page and About VTS page (established 2007; 24 h manning per MSC.348(91) para 7.3.1).

batch_audits.pass2_evidence_check: Reopened R-S1 (SN.1/Circ.318 text, boundary A to H and para 3.1.1), R-S2 and R-S4 (passages re-fetched and matched verbatim on 29 Sep 2026), R-S6/R-S7 (WFS polygons re-parsed; inclusion tested per vertex with rhumb-line and linear interpolation, both give positive margins for all five TSS). All five BARENTS SRS links supported by two independent official sources (Kystverket statement plus geometry).
batch_audits.pass3_classification_duplicate_check: One reporting scheme (VRS-0009, existing ID reused) linked to five TSS, not duplicated. Vardø VTS centre recorded once as a service; its Melkøya VTS area does not overlap any TSS, so no VTS link. Barents SRS reporting to Vardø VTS centre treated as MRS, not as VTS coverage. Parent B-II/19 versus component TSS kept separate.
batch_audits.unresolved_items: None affecting classification. Project-policy note: NOR VTS monitoring/information service for TSS outside declared VTS areas recorded only as a lead.

batch_audits.pass2_evidence_check: Same sources reopened. Andenes and both Røst clusters inside Barents SRS boundary (margins about 9.1, 10.8 and 20.6 nm); Træna (min lat 65°40'N) and Halten (64°09'N) wholly south of the 67°10'N limit. WETREP limit (MSC.190(79) points 1 to 4) confirmed at 000°, not reaching 005°E to 007°E. VTS-area polygons re-checked: no overlap with any B15 TSS.
batch_audits.pass3_classification_duplicate_check: VRS-0009 reused for three TSS. Træna and Halten classed 'Neither confirmed' on the basis of the complete statutory VTS-area list and IMO Part I geometry, not a failed search. NOR VTS information service not counted as VTS or MRS. Røst (1)/(2) label-to-cluster mapping unconfirmed but both clusters classify identically.
batch_audits.unresolved_items: Røst (1)/(2) cluster mapping; residual absence of a consolidated list of Norwegian national reporting schemes for Træna and Halten (see records).

method_notes: Research date 29 September 2026. lovdata.no blocked curl (HTTP 405); FOR-2021-02-10-523 was read through WebFetch, whose summarising model gave inconsistent paraphrases of §§170 to 172, so only the §6 list of service areas (corroborated by Kystverket's WFS attributes 'Sjøtrafikkforskriften §6') is relied on; no Lovdata text is quoted beyond that list. COLREG.2/Circ.75 (2021 Norway routeing amendments) could not be downloaded (mirror connection reset), so TSS positions come from Kystverket's official TSS polygons (WFS layer_706, which the Kystinfo map incorporated by Sjøtrafikkforskriften §171 is built on). The WFS names eight clusters 'mellom Vardø og Røst', matching IMO components Vardø, Slettnes, North Cape, Sørøya, Torsvåg, Andenes, Røst (1), Røst (2) by position; names of individual clusters are inferred from geography except Træna and Halten, which are named. Barents SRS inclusion tested per polygon vertex against MSC.348(91) points A to H. Lead corrections: BARENTS SRS was adopted by MSC.348(91) (28 Nov 2012, in force 1 June 2013), not MSC.210(81). The 'Vardø to Røst' TSS entered into force in 2007 per Kystverket (COLREG.2/Circ.58 not opened). Norwegian coastal TSS are not in any Norwegian VTS area; Vardø VTS centre monitors them as an information service and receives Barents SRS reports. The Røst to Oslofjord lead is out of this group's scope (Træna and Halten are the only southern components here; Runde, Stad, Sotra, Utsira etc. are later batches and likely share the Træna/Halten reasoning, subject to VTS-area overlap checks near Fedje/Kvitsøy/Kinn).
